title: Nvidia leads Reflection AI's $2B round

sources.quote: The funding was led by Nvidia and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
This investment has propelled the company’s valuation to a striking $8 billion.

explain: Nvidia led a $2 billion round in Reflection AI, a US lab building open-weight AI models, valuing it at $8 billion. Nvidia's own share of the round was not disclosed.
